clips.title: The story
paras: Promising priests from Elwynn Forest are summoned to Stormwind for further training in the Church of the Holy Light. After proving their devotion and discipline, they come before High Priestess Laurena at the Cathedral of Light.

Priestess Josetta guides novice priests in Goldshire, while other local mentors serve the outlying settlements of Elwynn Forest. When a disciple proves capable in spirit and deeds, word reaches the senior priesthood in Stormwind. A summons to the Cathedral of Light marks the move to deeper responsibilities in the faith and formal training at the spiritual heart of the Kingdom of Stormwind.

At the Cathedral, acolytes present themselves to High Priestess Laurena, one of the Church's senior leaders in Stormwind. She oversees their spiritual grounding and practical training as newly elevated priests. Her instruction prepares them for the harsh trials facing the Alliance and teaches the Light's miracles, including Desperate Prayer, the plea for salvation known among human practitioners.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've caught the attention of our superiors, friend. They've asked you travel to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Laurena. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad you've arrived, friend. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.
